title: Name Input
summary: Spots caps lock, all-lowercase, stray digits and swapped first/last names, and offers (never forces) a correctly cased fix.
description: Name field that spots caps lock, all-lowercase, stray digits, doubled spaces and a first/last mix-up, and offers, never forces, a fix cased the way McDonald, O'Brien, van der Berg and de la Cruz are really written, with a Keep option.
catches: First and last names swapped (from common-name lists)
A full name typed into one box: offers to split
Re-casing that respects Mc/Mac, O', particles and hyphens
limits: Casing and swap lists are English/Western-centric; they can be wrong for other naming traditions
Only suggests; some people really write their name in capitals or lowercase
Mac names are a list, so unlisted ones aren't re-cased
a11y: Visible label; input is described by a polite hint region
Warnings appear after a pause while typing
Keep button has an aria-label and title; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Names saved in caps or swapped
